flags: OWNERSHIP: local -> private. The operator is the Clay County Fair Association (Spencer), a 501(c)(5) tax-exempt organization (EIN 42-0185302, ProPublica), not the county; per the brief a nonprofit operator means private.

PRIVATE GATE: posted rates $20 (no utilities) / $35 (utilities) / $50 (utilities and sewer) per 24 hours; the base is $20, under US$50 (the $50 sewer site sits at the gate). No gateway within 40 km; never stayed. Presence: operator website with phone 712-580-3000; Google listing 4.6 stars / 1,126 reviews with the same phone. Price: posted rate. RV Life 3.5 stars ($, avg $15) - its review count wasn't returned; Google is well over 4.0.
NON-FAIR NIGHTS: the operator's own 'Non-Fair Time Camping' page sells ordinary nights April-October to anyone, first-come, separately from its Fair Time Camping page - passes the fairgrounds test.
LONG-STAY: no monthly or seasonal rate, no residents described; transient 24-hour pricing; passes the five tests.
HOOKUPS: 'utilities' is not broken out; water left as stored (true), electric amperage cleared to unknown.
PIN: stored 43.15530,-95.15551 is at the north gate on 18th Street between the camping fields and the track; Google's place is 43.15612,-95.15291 (~230 m). Fine.
